# Synthetic PDF viewer fixtures

These fictional fixtures are generated by `scripts/generate-pdf-fixtures.py` (optional developer tool using Pillow; no production dependency). No personal documents or downloaded test PDFs are included.

- `FieldGuide.pdf`: three pages, native text, standard Helvetica font, simple colored heading.
- `CMYK.pdf`: a native DeviceCMYK rectangle and standard text; exercises the packaged ICC/QCMS path.
- `JPX.pdf`: a generated 32×32 checkerboard encoded losslessly as JPEG 2000.
- `JBIG2.pdf`: a generated monochrome checkerboard, a small JBIG2 page with an MMR generic region.
- `CMap.pdf`: Type0 text with the packaged UniJIS-UCS2-H CMap; a deliberately synthetic CID font descriptor uses the library's font fallback.

Poppler rendering is a fixture sanity check. Actual pinned PDF.js worker rendering and explicit corrupt/blocked decoder tests remain separate acceptance gates.

The CMYK sample oracle uses the packaged `CGATS001Compat-v2-micro.icc` profile, rather than a generic screen conversion. Independent Pillow/LittleCMS conversion of the authored components rounded to CMYK bytes `(51,204,77,0)` yields RGB `(201,87,126)`; the renderer proof permits three levels per component for rounding. JPX checker samples use the generated exact RGB colors. JBIG2 checker samples use the black/white locations verified by Poppler.
